biggest_catch: Lab is in Amsterdam - in-person participation is local to the University of Amsterdam; pay-for-performance studies can pay as low as EUR 5/hour.
catches: Studies run in person at the ABS Behavioural Lab in Amsterdam - local availability matters
Pay-for-performance studies can pay as low as EUR 5/hour depending on task performance
Participants can also be paid in research credits instead of money (students)
Study invitations arrive over time; frequency of paid studies is not guaranteed
Session durations are not stated on the page

c1.evidence: abs.uva.nl ABS Behavioural Lab 'Participants' and 'For Researchers' pages (official University of Amsterdam domain, search index crawled 10 days before verification); pay rates quoted verbatim

c2.evidence: Official pages state: 'Participation will always be compensated at a rate of 10 Euro / 1 Research Credit per hour' and pay-for-performance studies 'can vary between 5 and 25 Euros per hour'

c3.evidence: Steps from official page: register as participant, be invited to studies with payment announced in advance, attend the timeslot, researcher registers payment/credit after the session

c4.evidence: Free to join the participant pool; no fee; behavioural experiments

eligibility: Anyone who registers for the ABS Behavioural Lab participant pool; exact payment or credit allocation is announced before each study
notes: Standing participant pool of the Amsterdam Business School Behavioural Lab (University of Amsterdam). Rates are per hour: EUR 10/hour standard, EUR 5-25/hour for pay-for-performance studies. EUR converted to USD at 1.147 (Sept 22-23, 2026 mid-market rate) and documented in payout_value_note.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (EUR 10/hr standard; EUR 5-25/hr pay-for-performance; converted at 1 EUR = 1.147 USD, Sept 22-23 2026); time: typical behavioural study session estimate since page does not state durations
payout_quote: Participation will always be compensated at a rate of 10 Euro/ 1 Research Credit per hour. Only in pay-for-performance studies, the overall payment (fix + variable) can vary between 5 and 25 Euros per hour, dependent on the performance in the task.
payout_value_note: EUR 5 and EUR 25 converted at 1 EUR = 1.147 USD (mid-market, Sept 22-23 2026) = $5.74-$28.68 per hour; standard rate EUR 10/hr = $11.47.

s1.note: EUR converted to USD at documented rate; pay-for-performance floor/ceiling disclosed

s2.note: Framed as per-hour lab pay, not steady income; performance variance disclosed

s3.note: Catches cover Amsterdam locality, EUR 5/hr floor, credit alternative

s5.note: Timing: researcher registers payment/credit after the timeslot concludes; disbursement timing not stated

s6.note: Deduped: no Amsterdam/ABS route in catalog; abs.uva.nl is University of Amsterdam (not UVA Darden R3066)

s7.note: No material weasel words in the rate statements

steps: Register for the ABS Behavioural Lab participant pool
Receive invitations to studies with the payment or credit allocation announced in advance
Choose a study and attend the timeslot
The researcher registers your payment or research credit after the timeslot concludes
timing: Researcher registers payment/credit after the timeslot concludes; disbursement timing not stated.
